Review README.md and /src to update this repository overview. .NET 10 (`net10.0`), latest C#, nullable and implicit usings enabled; warnings are errors. Projects: `src/`, `tests/`; solution: `Template.slnx`. Shared settings: `Directory.Build.props`; centralized package versions: `Directory.Packages.props`. Add packages there via `<PackageVersion Include="PackageName" Version="x.y.z" />`; omit versions in `.csproj`.

Use file-scoped namespaces; `_camelCase` private fields, PascalCase constants, `var` when appropriate, `I` interfaces, `Async` methods. Two-space indent, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM; Allman braces. Primary constructors preferred; ALWAYS assign to readonly fields. Run `dotnet format`.

Never hardcode sensitive information in source code. Avoid logging sensitive information. Validate/sanitize inputs; follow OWASP, use HTTPS, parameterized queries, proper auth. UI invalid input gets user-friendly errors; non-UI uses guard clauses/exceptions. Use `Ardalis.GuardClauses`; prefer FluentValidation for complex validation.

Use DI, focused/testable code, async I/O, structured contextual logging, and suitable HTTP status codes. Prefer FastEndpoints REPR, DDD where applicable, layer-specific Request/Response, Command/Query, DTO suffixes; avoid interfaces and implementations in same project.

Production in `src/`, tests in `tests/`; use xUnit. Run `dotnet run --project src/YourProject/YourProject.csproj`. AAA tests; feature-mirrored folders; `[Fact]`/`[Theory]`; name classes `ClassName_MethodName.cs`, methods `DoesSomething_GivenSomeCondition`; no “Tests” class suffix. Prefer NSubstitute and Shouldly; avoid commercially licensed test libraries. Test only controlled business logic.

Use Markdown docs with headings, syntax-highlighted snippets, blank lines around lists/code, and lint documentation.
